sources.title: Local Area Unemployment Statistics: cities, county, state, and national, not seasonally adjusted
sources.notes: The most recent month is preliminary and is revised the following month.
sources.apa: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics. (2026). Local Area Unemployment Statistics: cities, county, state, and national, not seasonally adjusted [Data set]. Retrieved November 26, 2026, from https://www.bls.gov/lau/

gap_notes.2025-10: BLS states that October 2025 data collection for the Current Population Survey, the primary input to these estimates, did not occur because of the 2025 lapse in federal appropriations (https://www.bls.gov/lau/launews1.htm).

data.scope_note: City figures describe whole cities. Most of Los Angeles and Long Beach lies outside the district, so their rates are context, not district figures. BLS publishes no congressional-district series.
